The crash was caused by `android.os.NetworkOnMainThreadException` because the blocking network call `CatalogClient().fetchCatalog()` was being executed synchronously on Android's main (UI) thread inside the button click listener in [MainActivity.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c3-agy-B-r1/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/MainActivity.kt).

### Changes Made
In [MainActivity.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c3-agy-B-r1/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/MainActivity.kt#L25-L36):
- Launched a coroutine within `lifecycleScope` on the click event.
- Moved the blocking `CatalogClient().fetchCatalog()` execution off the main thread using `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)`.
- Updated the UI (`output.text`) safely back on the main thread once the network call completes.
